title: Cryo-electron microscopy reveals a single domain antibody with a unique binding epitope on fibroblast activation protein alpha
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2025, 6,780-787
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00267A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zhen Xu, Akesh Sinha, Darpan N. Pandya, Nicholas J. Schnicker, Thaddeus J. Wadas
The single domain antibody, I3, interacts with fibroblast activation protein alpha through its CDR3 loop and FR2 region to bind a unique and previously undisclosed epitope that is distinct from the protease's active site.
